base.description: open onto that pushed branch instead of main: the layer below in a stack, linked after with x lane stack link

stack.description: the head is a stack's top pr: seed its tree, and list every layer under it bottom-up with its pr, head and base

verbs.name: lane restack
verbs.purpose: merge each lower layer of this branch's stack up into the next and push each moved one; hidden while stacks are on trial
touches: origin — the stack's layer branches, pushed from the push home lane push uses

verbs.name: lane stack link
verbs.purpose: link this branch's layers (<branch>, -2, -3 on origin) into a github stack, bottom-up; hidden while stacks are on trial
touches: github — a stack of the layers' prs, as the x-codie-cc app

verbs.name: lane stack view
verbs.purpose: print the github stack this branch's pr sits in, bottom-up, with each pr and state; hidden while stacks are on trial
touches: github — the stacks api and the open prs, read as the x-codie-cc app
